name: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
description: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO: Under sustained checkout traffic, long-running batch reconciliation queries hold pool connections without returning them to the HikariCP pool, causing HTTP 500s across the checkout pipeline.

name: Payment Gateway Timeout & Cascade Failure
description: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO: Upstream payment processor API starts experiencing 15s latency spikes. Without circuit breaker tripping, worker threads in checkout-gateway exhaust thread pools, resulting in 504 Gateway Timeouts.

name: Auth Token Refresh Storm & Rate Limit Rejection
description: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO: A misconfigured mobile app client retries expired JWT token refreshes in a zero-backoff loop, exhausting Redis rate-limit counters and rejecting legitimate logins with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
